Stories

Women's Golf
|
April 7
Skyhawks women wrap up final regular season appearance
TUCSON, Ariz. – Senior Dimery Plewe and sophomore Peyton Gibby both recorded top 50 finishes en route to helping the Fort Lewis Skyhawks women's golf team to a 13th-place team finish on a 650 (+74) team score at the West Texas A&M Desert Invitational at the challenging Ventana Canyon Club and Lodge. Read More+
Softball
|
April 10
Skyhawks to meet Mavericks in Grand Junction on Saturday/Sunday
DURANGO, Colo. – The Fort Lewis softball team (7-31, 6-22 RMAC) is hitting the road for the first time this April as the Skyhawks soar up the Western Slope to meet the Colorado Mesa University Mavericks (18-18, 17-11 RMAC) for a four-game Rocky Mountain Athletic Conference series this Saturday and Sunday... Read More+
Women's Lacrosse
|
April 10
Women's lacrosse continues season on the road
DURANGO, Colo. – The Fort Lewis College women's lacrosse team will travel to Pueblo this week for a standalone Sunday contest against CSU Pueblo in Rocky Mountain Athletic Conference (RMAC) action. Read More+
Women's Track & Field
|
April 9
Hartwell named RMAC First Team All-Academic to lead Skyhawks
COLORADO SPRINGS, Colo. – Senior Hannah Hartwell was named to the Rocky Mountain Athletic Conference's (RMAC) All-Academic First Team to headline academic awards for men's and women's indoor track and field. Read More+
Men's Golf
|
April 7
Skyhawks men take sixth at RJGA Palm Valley Classic
GOODYEAR, Ariz. – With Traejan Andrews leading the charge with a T-8 finish as an individual, the Fort Lewis Skyhawks men's golf team ultimately shot its best round of the tournament to capture sixth-place as a team on an 843 (-21) at the Ruidoso Junior Golf Association Palm Valley Classic at Palm Valley...
